passages.note: Campaign-forum account of killing the marriage constitutional amendment in committee and opposing attacks on 'marriage equality'; shows the pro-equality side but names no clause separating full equality with anti-discrimination protection, equal marriage, or a religious carve-out.
Nay on third reading of a one-man-one-woman constitutional amendment rules out the ban side only; a No on a ban does not choose among the rungs on the other side.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: Engrossed House text of the amendment he voted against; operative section is a marriage definition, so opposing it shows only a side.
Bill details page (digest and actions) for the same instrument; prints neither his vote nor the House tally.

rows.reasoning: His Nay on HJR 3 (2014), whose operative text is 'Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana', and his 2026 forum account of killing that amendment in committee show he opposes making same-sex marriage illegal. Neither passage separates 'equal marriage plus protection from discrimination' from 'the same benefits and protections as any other marriage' or from a religious-organization carve-out, so only the side is evidenced.
